query: What environmental monitoring thresholds (soil P accumulation, N leaching proxies) and sampling frequencies should trigger restrictions or adaptive rules for manure/compost use?

response.query: What environmental monitoring thresholds (soil P accumulation, N leaching proxies) and sampling frequencies should trigger restrictions or adaptive rules for manure/compost use?
response.answer: Soil P accumulation above 250 mg/kg and N leaching proxies above 20 kg/ha/year trigger restrictions on manure/compost use. Annual sampling is recommended to monitor these thresholds.
